info.name: Get the details for an identity breach

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the breach to fetch

items.docs:
Returns the details of an identity breach.

Required API key permissions: `IdentityBreaches` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

info.name: Get a list of breached identities

params.name: page_token
params.description: The `page_token` from a previous request, use this to get the next page of results.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
The value to sort the breached identities by

If not specified will default to `date_last_breach` and set `sort_desc` to `true`

params.name: sort_desc
params.description: Whether or not to sort the results in descending order

params.name: breach_id
params.description: The breach ID to filter on

items.docs:
Returns a list of identities ordered by last breached date.

Required API key permissions: `IdentityBreaches` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: page_token
params.description: The `page_token` from a previous request, use this to get the next page of results.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
List of fields to sort VIPs by, with optional :asc or :desc suffix per field.
Allowed fields: name, domain, num_breaches, date_last_breach.

items.docs:
Returns a list of VIPs for your account.

Required API key permissions: `IdentityBreaches` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: email
params.description: The email of the VIP to add. Must be an authorized company domain for your account.

items.docs:
Add a VIP to your account.

Required API key permissions: `IdentityBreaches` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: email
params.description: The email of the VIP to remove.

items.docs:
Remove a VIP from your account.

Required API key permissions: `IdentityBreaches` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)
